read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 4.7% on Oct 19 to $142.87, trading between $141.27 and $146.00; with 71 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its falling 5-day ($146.0), 10-day ($159.3) and 30-day ($178.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($174.74), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月19日上涨 4.7%，收于 $142.87，盘中区间 $141.27–146.00；上市仅 71 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$146.0）、10 日（$159.3）和 30 日均线（$178.0）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$174.74），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $137.8 Oct 15 low, but the day's high stopped at the 5-day average and the $145.6 Jul 17 pivot. Resistance is $145.6–146.0, then $151.5 (Aug 24 low) and $159.3 (10-day). Support is $137.8, then $133.8 (Aug 7 low) and $124.8 (Jul 29 low, the lowest since listing). A close above $146 would target $151.5; a close below $133.8 would open $124.8.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $137.8 的 10月15日低点，但当日高点止步于 5 日均线和 $145.6 的 7月17日转折点。阻力为 $145.6–146.0，其次 $151.5（8月24日低点）和 $159.3（10 日均线）。支撑为 $137.8，其次 $133.8（8月7日低点）和 $124.8（7月29日低点，上市以来最低）。若收盘站上 $146，下一目标看 $151.5；若收盘跌破 $133.8，下一目标看 $124.8。

bias.en: Bearish · rebounded off the July low

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,277,000 in Seoul on Oct 19, up 0.4%, after dipping to ₩1,208,000 and closing at the day's high. It is below its falling 5-day (₩1,334,600), 10-day (₩1,529,600) and 30-day (₩1,690,300) averages, the falling 100-day (₩1,910,670) and the rising 200-day (₩1,460,445). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 29 (₩1,635,732), and RSI is 26.
read.zh: SK 海力士 10月19日在首尔收于 ₩1,277,000，上涨 0.4%；盘中一度跌至 ₩1,208,000，随后以全日最高价收盘。股价位于下行的 5 日（₩1,334,600）、10 日（₩1,529,600）和 30 日均线（₩1,690,300）、下行的 100 日均线（₩1,910,670）及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,460,445）下方。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 9月29日起看空（₩1,635,732），RSI 为 26。

read.en: The low undercut the ₩1,238,000–1,246,000 Oct 15 and Jul 29 lows, but the close recovered above them for a third session. Resistance is ₩1.33 million (Oct 15–16 highs, 5-day average), then ₩1.37–1.40 million (Aug 11 and Oct 14 lows) and ₩1,460,445 (200-day). Support is ₩1,238,000–1,246,000, then ₩1,208,000 (Oct 19 low, near ₩1.2 million) and ₩1,060,000 (Mar 18 high). A close below ₩1,208,000 would open ₩1,060,000.
